title: 第1段階 はじめの一歩 10

A.q: What will the man say next?
choices: Please go to bed early today.
A.ja: （男）ミナ、つかれた顔をしているね。どうしたの？／（女）昨夜よく眠れなかったの。
A.why: 眠れなかった人に、「今日は早く寝てね」が自然。
script: Man: You look tired, Mina. What's wrong?
Woman: I didn't sleep well last night.

A.ja: （女）映画は何時に始まるの？／（男）7時30分だよ。7時に会おう。
A.why: 始まる時間と、会う時間はちがう。
script: Woman: What time does the movie start?
Man: At seven thirty. Let's meet at seven.

B.ja: （男）エミリー、だいじょうぶ？／（女）ううん。頭がいたいの。
script: Woman: No. I have a headache.

B.ja: （女）サム、気分はどう？／（サム）うれしいよ！テストでいい点をとったんだ。
script: Woman: How do you feel, Sam?
Man: I'm happy! I got a good score on the test.

Hello. I'm Mike. I'm a doctor. Every day, many people come to see me. Some have a cold, and some have a stomachache. I tell them to rest and drink water. I also tell them to eat good food. My message is simple: sleep well, eat well, and move your body. I walk to work every day. It takes twenty minutes.
C1.ja: こんにちは。マイクです。医者です。毎日、たくさんの人がわたしに会いに来ます。かぜの人も、おなかがいたい人もいます。わたしは、休んで水を飲むように言います。いい食事をとるようにも言います。わたしのメッセージは簡単です。よく寝て、よく食べて、体を動かそう。わたしは毎日、歩いて仕事に行きます。20分かかります。

qs.q: What does Mike tell people to do?
qs.why: I tell them to rest and drink water.

qs.q: How does Mike go to work?
qs.why: I walk to work every day.

script: Sam: Yes. I played games until two in the morning.
Sam: I know. I have a test today, but I can't think well.
Lisa: Here. Drink this water and wash your face.
C2.ja: （リサ）サム、ねむそうだね。／（サム）うん。夜中の2時までゲームをしていたんだ。／（リサ）2時？遅すぎるよ！／（サム）わかってる。今日テストがあるのに、うまく考えられない。／（リサ）はい。この水を飲んで、顔を洗いなよ。／（サム）ありがとう、リサ。

qs.q: What time did Sam play games until?
What does Lisa tell Sam to do?
choices: Drink water and wash his face.
qs.why: Drink this water and wash your face.
